svg.title: Complete MCP6022 receiver wiring — all components
svg.desc: One complete connection sheet for the existing receiver circuit. Numbered circles identify physical MCP6022 pins. Repeated pin numbers and matching net labels are the same connection. Includes pins 1 and 2 wire, both 100 kohm and 220 picofarad between pins 6 and 7, all power, reference, protection and ADC components.

g.text: One MCP6022 + one receive piezo + one ESP32 · breadboard version from Part 1
Same numbered circle = same chip leg. Same named label = same wire connection.
Writing faces down; marked pin-1 corner is upper right.
VREF comes from pin 1. It is NOT ground.
R = resistor · C = capacitor · D = diode
Each R/C/D label names ONE physical component.
Wire shapes show connections, not required wire lengths.
M and VREF are separate nodes.
D1 stripe → VREF. D2 stripe → pin 5. The diodes face opposite ways.
4 GAIN + FILTER — BOTH parts between pins 6 and 7
R6 and C5 are parallel: each has one end at pin 6 and one at pin 7.
C6 is on the D34 side of R7.
ESP32 GND and chip pin 4 share ground.
TOTAL: 7 resistors · 6 capacitors · 2 diodes · 1 MCP6022 · 1 piezo · 1 ESP32
C2 and C4: 10 µF electrolytic, ≥6.3 V rating. All other capacitors: non-polar ceramic.
Power the MCP6022 from 3V3, not 5 V. Never connect a bare piezo straight to D34.
